usedFor: PixelBin.io manages your images, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers when “File Created” fires “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “File Created” in PixelBin.io, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new image upload can start a local script, such as a backup or a resize job.

watchOut: “Delete File” is also a PixelBin.io trigger, so check that each template listens to “File Created”.
